title: Land-guarded detection benchmark
summary: Land-guarded labels plus masked R46/R47 ensemble and four-pass TTA at 0.60 yielded recorded IoU 0.6440; unmasked inference on guarded labels yielded 0.4692. Selection and threshold tuning reused test evidence.
